messages:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — moving the 'Model rollout' demo from 10:30 -> 11:00. Recording team, please start local backup capture now. We may need an OBS fallback.

lina: On it. Starting OBS local record + enabling captions. Where are the final slides?

sanjay: Slides uploaded to #all-hands-assets (s3://redwood-allhands/2026-03-23/slides.pdf). Use the latest deck (v3).

alex: Main stream captions are lagging ~6s for viewers. If we switch encoders we'll lose ~10s — ok to proceed? :thinking_face:

sam: I'll cut over to backup encoder-02 in 30s. Running: `./switch_encoder --target encoder-02 --grace 15`

ops-bot: encoder-02 health check: OK. Available disk: 120GB.

lina: Confirmed OBS local recording started. Captions enabled (provider: live-captioner v1.4). I'll monitor A/V.

maria: Quick roadmap Q for leadership before we start Q&A: will the Dedicated capacity pricing change in Q3 affect existing reserved pools?

jonathan: @maria — short answer: no immediate forced changes for existing committed pools. We'll share a cherrypicked timeline in the follow-up email. We'll take detailed Qs in the Q&A slot.

alex: Encoder switched, stream health looks stable. Watch for a small artifacts blip at the cutover (T+12s).

sanjay: Thanks — can someone clip the Model rollout demo for the docs team when it's done? Prefer 3-4 minute highlight.

lina: Yep, will export a clip and drop in #all-hands-assets.

maria: Thanks. Also can leadership confirm whether the rollout will have a canary for public customers?

jonathan: Yes — canary on 10% traffic initially, with automatic rollback on latency or error threshold. We'll include metric thresholds in the follow-up notes.

sanjay: OK team — final call: 30s to live. Keep replies short in thread during stream. If anything breaks, ping @eng-oncall directly. :thumbsup:
